svg.title: One tools/call request carrying every piece of context the server needs
svg.desc: A single JSON-RPC request is written out on the left, a tools slash call naming get_system_info. Inside its params sits a _meta object holding six keys. The first two, protocolVersion and clientCapabilities, are marked with a coloured bar meaning required; the remaining four, clientInfo, logLevel, progressToken and traceparent, are optional. A leader line runs from each key to a card on the right explaining what that key tells the server. A footnote expands the abbreviated prefix as io dot modelcontextprotocol slash, and a closing note says a request missing either marked key is malformed and must be answered with error code minus 32602.
svg.text: Everything the server needs, in one message
There is no earlier message to remember, so the request carries its own context.
Which revision this message speaks. Required.
Required, and scoped to this request alone.
Self-reported. Good for logs, never for security.
Opt in. No key means no log notifications.
Opt into progress on this request’s stream.
W3C Trace Context. Unprefixed on purpose.
Miss either marked key and the request is malformed. The server must answer -32602.
